decisions.statement: A track Alan has heard is never picked.
A track whose artist Alan does not follow is never picked.
A track Spotify does not name is never picked.
One track of a track key is picked and the rest of that key are not.
A track stating no track key is never folded into a key.
The track picked for a key is the first that key reaches in order.
An artist's tracks run together rather than being dealt among other artists.
Artists run in the order of their slugs.
Tracks of one artist are ordered by the day their release came out.
A track whose release states no day comes after every track whose release states one.
Tracks that came out on one day keep the order their release carries them in.
A tie no other rule settles goes by slug.
Nothing here reads the page store.
A track's Spotify id, disc and position are read off the release it is picked under.
A track is picked once, whatever releases carry that track.

definition: the tracks a followed artist made that Alan has not heard
